¡Bienvenidos al Árbol Luminoso! Tres tesoros están escondidos en la pintura. Muévete despacio y escucha: los pitidos se aceleran cuando te acercas.
Un gran árbol brilla desde adentro. Sus ramas se extienden por un cielo naranja y azul, y una multitud de personas está debajo.
Move slowly and listen. When the beeps race and your phone buzzes, you are right on top of it.
Nice one!
¡Los encontraste todos! Gracias por jugar con el Árbol Luminoso.
Encontraste el corazón del árbol. Brilla con una luz dorada.
Encontraste a la gente reunida bajo el árbol, mirando hacia arriba.
Encontraste el cielo naranja y azul, como un atardecer pintado.
Welcome to the Glowing Tree. Flip the cards and find the matching pairs. Every pair sings its own note, so you can match them by ear.
A great tree glows from within. Its branches spread across a sky of orange and blue, and a crowd of people stands beneath it.
Listen for the notes. Two cards that sing the same note are a pair.
All pairs found! The tree is glowing just for you.
Welcome to Into the Light. Three treasures are hidden in the painting. Move slowly and listen: the beeps race when you are close.
A figure with a white cane walks into a blaze of orange, red and blue. The paint drips and runs like rain on a window.
You found them all. Thank you for walking into the light with us.
You found the traveller. His white cane leads him toward the light.
A cool blue flame, burning through the fire.
The paint pools at his feet like light on a wet street.
Welcome to the Tunnel of Light! Tilt or steer the eyeball and collect every star. Listen: the beeps lead you to the next one.
A lone traveller stands in a tunnel of light. Swirls of deep blue and gold spin around him, and the light ahead is warm and bright.
Listen to the beeps. They point you to the nearest star. Faster means closer.
You did it! Every star is home. Thank you for playing in the Tunnel of Light.
The Tunnel of Light is in pieces. Slide them back into place. Each piece sings when it finds its home.
This is Tunnel Puzzle by Blind Canvas Project. Tell your players what they are looking at: the colours, the shapes, and the story behind it.
Start with the top row. Press Peek to see the whole painting.
Solved! The tunnel is whole again.
